feasibility.high_roi: Potential small source-specific educational region/terminology reference once legitimate passages and independent source examples are verified. Morphology labels can be descriptive only; no foot-to-character,intellect,criminality or health judgments.
feasibility.calculation: No deterministic scientific forecast algorithm established by catalogs. Any future matcher must be documentary and explicit about unsupported combinations,not an appearance-based trait classifier.
feasibility.inputs: Prefer generic teaching schematic labels or historical text selections. Original image/user-morphology options preserved in inventory metadata,not implemented. No photo recognition pipeline.
feasibility.scope_boundary: Do not mix Somogyi,Sheehan or Indian traditions. No reflexology,medical diagnosis,psychological/personality assessment or disease-cause inference.
feasibility.access: Rank1 commercial publisher metadata only; rank2 author edition verified. Public free-resource lead is newsletter-gated; no signup or inaccessible-book search performed.
